digest.component_or_area: plan vocabulary and review gate system
propositions: Rebar's plan vocabulary carries two distinct headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) for a single concept, with no semantic differentiation in actual gate implementation or criterion routing
All criteria processing currently pools both heading types under a single bar, making the SC/AC split vestigial and actively harmful to checkability, countability, and operator attestation

The SC/AC vocabulary split must be collapsed into unified Acceptance Criteria across detector regexes, reviewer prompts, routing indices, author guides, generated criteria documentation, eval specs, test fixtures, and 106 extant store tickets

Store ticket migration requires converting Success Criteria bullets into Acceptance Criteria checkboxes counted by _count_ac_items, with permanent carve-outs for dod_uncertifiable (three verifier/kernel files), plan_review_T2.md (trial metrics), frozen test fixtures, and O-RAN-SC vendor references

ADR 0053 grandfathering of registry drift at the claim gate makes this vocabulary collapse now affordable, whereas prior ticket invalidations (632 tickets affected) rendered it prohibitively expensive
